description: a pane in copy mode takes keys through the copy-mode table: a binding there (bind -T copy-mode C-t) fires and tmux consumes the key; whykey asks about the pane from outside it, because typing whykey into a pane in copy mode would reach the copy-mode table instead of the shell
label: consumed
